chars.R: RACHID: a tall slim young Moroccan man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans and white sneakers.
chars.B: RABAB: a short young Moroccan woman wearing a red leather jacket over a black top, light grey wide trousers and a small black crossbody bag.
chars.F: SALMA: a young Moroccan woman wearing a green denim jacket, a white t-shirt and black trousers, holding a smartphone.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: RACHID and RABAB laugh happily together, walking side by side on the seaside promenade of the Corniche in Casablanca at sunset, the ocean and palm trees behind them, relaxed joyful mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: At night RACHID lies on his bed in his small Casablanca bedroom, surprised, staring at his glowing smartphone that just buzzed with a message, eyebrows raised, lamp light.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: SALMA sits alone on a sofa in a dim living room at night, typing a message on her smartphone with a serious worried face, leaning forward secretly.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot of RACHID sitting up on his bed holding his smartphone with both hands, reading with a shocked face and open mouth, dark bedroom.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: RABAB walks at night on a Casablanca street toward the entrance of an apartment building, looking back over her shoulder suspiciously, streetlights, mysterious mood.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: SALMA stands on a small balcony at night, holding her smartphone near her face, whispering and looking around nervously as if hiding something, city lights behind her.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: RACHID paces nervously in his bedroom at night, one hand on his head, the other holding his phone, confused and doubtful.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: RACHID and RABAB sit facing each other at a small table in a Casablanca cafe terrace, two glasses of mint tea, RABAB smiles normally while RACHID looks tense and thoughtful.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: RACHID shows his smartphone screen to RABAB across the cafe table with a serious questioning face; RABAB leans back, frozen, eyes wide in surprise, tense dramatic moment.
